name: Hint Line '93
source:
Step back to the golden era of videogame hint lines. As callers scramble for help with cryptic games, you consult The Compendium – a binder of conflicting notes, maps and corporate propaganda. This visual novel blends digital play with physical objects: sit at the 90s-style desk, flip through the compendium, and solve puzzles on a CRT monitor.

[From [url=https://www.acmi.net.au/works/125408--hint-line-93/]ACMI[/url]]
